verdict.rationale: Intuit's developer index lists a first-party Webhooks page for the QuickBooks Workforce (payroll) API, so integrations can stay informed when a connected company runs payroll or adds or updates records. That makes event subscription a direct, documented capability. The evidence is only a truncated index entry, so its depth is unproven. Missing for 10: details on registering webhook endpoints, the full list of subscribable event types, payload and signature/verification docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
